dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000s799](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000s799) Magnitude 5.5 earthquake at 10.0 depth occurred on Feb 08 2026 35km SE of Imías. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 19.8899 longitude -74.371. It impacted 65621 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
